rounds.title: Divider baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK divider (et-divider), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design: a horizontal rule between two paragraphs, vertical rules in a flex row of three labels (one separator, one decorative), and decorative rules with a 16px inset between list rows. The divider has one visible element, a 1px rule in --et-divider-color, falling back to --et-surface-border-solid. Numbers, measured on the page background: the rule is #e5e5e5 on #ffffff, 1.26:1 light, and #404040 on #171717, 1.73:1 dark, in every state. No decided rule applies: the divider has no focus ring (Q88), no mint, dots or text of its own (Q99 rule a), so the round holds variant a only. Its contrast is the open edge question (Q98): numbers only, no variant drawn for it.

a.note: Today: 1px rule in the surface border colour, 1.26:1 against the light page (#e5e5e5 on #ffffff), 1.73:1 against the dark page (#404040 on #171717). Horizontal, vertical and inset look the same; decorative changes only the semantics.
